other_conditions: Applicant may have a lineage or belong to a family practicing a given folk form
Applicant may belong to a tribal cultural/dance team or be a folk‑based instrumentalist recognized by the Folk & Tribal Cultural Centre
Applicant must be a resident of West Bengal
benefits_summary: The scheme issues identity cards and provides a monthly pension or retainer fee of ₹1000, along with performance‑based fees for eligible folk artists.
